audit_groups.title: Finite free coordinates and topology
audit_groups.finding: A finite injective local map of complete DVRs has j(t)=v*u^e with v a unit and e>=1. Torsion-free finiteness makes B a finite free A-module. Its coordinate maps satisfy p_a(u^(eN)B) subset t^N A, including ramified extensions.

audit_groups.title: Exact recombination factors
audit_groups.finding: For N=max s_a, coefficients v^(-N)*b_a*j(t^(N-s_a)) recombine j(t^s_a*p_a(y)) to u^(eN)*y. Both the inverse-unit factor and ramification exponent are necessary. The maximum, rather than a sum, is valid.

audit_groups.title: Original Selmer and boundary conditions
audit_groups.finding: Each projection commutes with multiplication by transported coefficients, transpose and the zero-entry conditions. It preserves all original local witnesses, inertial vanishings, cocycle equations, support and skew boundaries. It is not assumed to be a ring map or to commute with arbitrary B-coefficient products.

audit_groups.title: Independence and generation of odd family
audit_groups.finding: Project each coefficient of a relation and its skew primitive to get an original relation. Coordinate reconstruction proves independence over B. Project an arbitrary B-valued Selmer cocycle and every local witness, use original generation and recombine with the exact factors to obtain generation up to a power of u.

audit_groups.title: Paired detection on the same set
audit_groups.finding: The paired coefficient algebra and exact W module extend by tensor product. The paired representation, twist and eta functional are transported. Applying coordinate maps preserves the detecting zero and polarization; recombining original polarized primitives proves Detects over B on the same chosen set.

audit_groups.title: Full cyclotomic coefficient character
audit_groups.finding: Any unital map from Z_ell into a characteristic-ell ring factors through F_ell, so the old and transported cyclotomic coefficient characters agree. The original full cyclotomic subgroup and all group maps remain fixed.

audit_groups.title: Finite separable splitting and integral roots
audit_groups.finding: Each selected characteristic polynomial is monic and separable over k((t)); a common finite separable splitting field exists even if different polynomials share roots. Its integral closure is a finite local complete DVR. All roots are integral and pairwise distinct within each polynomial. Distinctness does not assert unit root differences.

audit_groups.title: Coefficient field and residue synchronization
audit_groups.finding: Unique Hensel lifts of the roots of X^Q-X form a coefficient field in equal characteristic. Uniformizer expansion gives B isomorphic to F_Q[[u]]. Finite constant-field extensions to a common degree synchronize residue cardinalities and preserve all previous conclusions. Empty selected-polynomial lists are covered.

audit_groups.title: Actual normalized-point extension
audit_groups.finding: PadicHomUnique84–163 constructs the normalized point after the finite local extension, preserving Ext2: representation, block partition, local basis and ordinary type. Original form, inertia, triangular identities and zero entries push along the ring map; ordinary-character inequalities use injectivity. Coordinate decomposition and recombination preserve the integral even-span property.

audit_groups.title: Complete original choice interface
audit_groups.finding: The new corollary matches PatchedSupportCompletions223–230: under given normalized points, Phi, odd characteristic, nontrivial residual cyclotomic character and N3, it provides finite local injective coefficient extensions, equal residue cardinalities, odd families, one common detecting set in the original H, and distinct splitting roots. The preceding finite-selection result constructs the odd family; no additional family-existence assumption remains.
